# Open USD (OUSD)

## Overview

[Open USD (OUSD)](https://joinopenstandard.com) is a USD stablecoin available through
`viem/tokens`.

Add `ousd` to a Client to use it with [Token Actions](/tokens/actions).

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"b36fd0c38abbf48b2e87d68966388324fdc692f060589bab3ae034ae76348c32","data":""}
import { Client, http } from 'viem'
import { Account } from 'viem'
import { tempo } from 'viem/chains'
import { ousd } from 'viem/tokens'

export const client = Client.create({
  account: Account.fromPrivateKey('0x...'),
  chain: tempo,
  tokens: [ousd],
  transport: http(),
})
```

## Read Open USD Balances

Use [`getBalance`](/tokens/actions/getBalance) to read an account's balance.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"bc99615f06bc69a258256cdf402eb600517445315c9f20362c162f8da5cf73e0","data":""}
import { Actions } from 'viem'
import { client } from './viem.config'

const balance = await Actions.token.getBalance(client, {
  account: '0x55FE002aefF02F77364de339a1292923A15844B8',
  token: 'ousd', // [!code focus]
})
// @log: { amount: 1000000000n, decimals: 6, formatted: '1000' }
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"b36fd0c38abbf48b2e87d68966388324fdc692f060589bab3ae034ae76348c32","data":""}
import { Client, http } from 'viem'
import { Account } from 'viem'
import { tempo } from 'viem/chains'
import { ousd } from 'viem/tokens'

export const client = Client.create({
  account: Account.fromPrivateKey('0x...'),
  chain: tempo,
  tokens: [ousd],
  transport: http(),
})
```

:::

## Send Open USD

Use [`transfer`](/tokens/actions/transfer) to send Open USD to another account.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"3b4f02ce667227a2f9a8e40dd9454a99d6c224e666e5e3abf0479f47cc256f28","data":""}
import { Actions } from 'viem'
import { client } from './viem.config'

const hash = await Actions.token.transfer(client, {
  amount: { formatted: '10.5' }, // [!code focus]
  to: '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEbb',
  token: 'ousd', // [!code focus]
})
// @log: '0x…'
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"b36fd0c38abbf48b2e87d68966388324fdc692f060589bab3ae034ae76348c32","data":""}
import { Client, http } from 'viem'
import { Account } from 'viem'
import { tempo } from 'viem/chains'

export const client = Client.create({
  account: Account.fromPrivateKey('0x...'),
  chain: tempo,
  tokens: [ousd],
  transport: http(),
})
```

:::
